candidates.name: Tuberculosis
support_spans: a painful nonhealing ulcer on his right hallux
an induced sputum was trace positive for MTB on GeneXpert and subsequently grew MTB sensitive to rifampicin and isoniazid
Biopsy of the toe ulcer showed necrotizing granulomatous inflammation with a solitary acid-fast bacillus
MRI of the spine revealed contiguous spondylitis from T6 to T10 with discitis and an epidural/paraspinal collection causing spinal cord compression
contradict_spans: He had two sputum GeneXpert tests at local clinics, both negative
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and test results, including the presence of MTB in the sputum and biopsy of the toe ulcer, are consistent with a diagnosis of Tuberculosis.

candidates.name: Pott's disease
